title: Replace and Compress
statement: The task is to count the distinct strings obtainable from a binary string (total length up to 3·10^5) by flipping at most one interior character and compressing each run (block) of equal characters to one. With the first character fixed and compressed strings alternating, only the run count matters; a flip changes it by +2, 0 or -2 depending on its two neighbours, so the answer is at most 3.
